title: MuseDesk Phase 3 ManagerAmendRequest
description: POST /v2/sessions/{session_id}/manager/plans/{plan_id}/amend. A change the user CONFIRMED (for example an agent's suggested change from a visit) becomes ONE new step for that agent on the committed plan, after after_task_id when that is one of the plan's cards. The reply is a ManagerCommitResult with only the new task and amended=true; manager.plan_committed is announced with the same task and amended=true. 409 PLAN_NOT_COMMITTED / REVISION_CONFLICT, 422 UNKNOWN_AGENT / EMPTY_CHANGE.
